name: Round-7.5 multi-axis polar blend (16 LLM-judged axes, K=4 N-way + BALD)
rationale: Round-7.5 successor to V16: 16 polar-prompt axes (LOW↔HIGH), K=4 N-way ranking with BALD active sampling on the full 15314-track Deezer corpus, multi-task linear probes with auxiliary tag-prediction loss from justification mining, ListMLE blend on a chosen target axis (timbre_roughness). Compared to V16 the polar prompts are designed to break the redundancy collapse round-7 saw between 22 axis pairs.
method: multi-axis polar-prompt linear probes + ListMLE blend, all L2-normalised
intensity_formula: score(x) = x · intensity_axis_vec  (equivalent to softmax-blended sum_k w_k * z(x · sub_k))

training_provenance.labels_source: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct-AWQ K=4 ranking + BALD active sampling
